review_text: Zoya Akhtar has outdone herself. Stellar Run is a masterpiece of action storytelling.
Gripping from start to finish. The action sequences are world class.
Finally a Bollywood action film that feels global. Standing ovation.
Dark Orbit had amazing visuals but the plot was confusing in the second half.
Expected more from Anurag Kashyap. Sci-fi is not his genre.
Visually stunning but emotionally distant. Could have been tighter.
Last Kingdom is a roaring success. Action packed and emotionally resonant.
Kabir Khan delivers again. Brilliant ensemble cast.
Solid action film with great writing. One of 2024s best.
The sequel nobody asked for. Feels forced and unfunny.
Some laughs but mostly disappointing. The original was better.
Rohit Shetty on autopilot. Loud, shallow, predictable.
Fun timepass but nothing memorable. Comedy felt stale.
Jugaad Junction is a mess. Poor script, poor execution.
Anees Bazmee seems to have lost the touch. Very disappointing.
Timeless. 3 Idiots never gets old no matter how many times you watch it.
PK is brilliant satire. Aamir Khan at his absolute best.
Bajrangi Bhaijaan still makes you cry every single time.
Andhadhun is a masterclass in suspense. Tabu is phenomenal.
Chhichhore is heartwarming and hilarious in equal measure.
Mitti Ki Khushboo is a beautiful love story set in rural India.
Imtiaz Ali weaves magic again. Gorgeous cinematography.
Paani tackles climate change with nuance and heart.
Watched twice already. Stellar Run is the film of the year.
The social media buzz around Stellar Run is 100% justified.
